title: The machine valuation of the archive: the valuation memo and Valuation 001
description: EA-VALUATION-MEMO-01 records eight machine valuations of one unpriced asset in one day, spanning three orders of magnitude. It forecasts that a first institutional customer would change the valuation's basis and that entity disambiguation, frame supply and provenance retention are becoming operational requirements, and states the conditions under which the $2M thesis collapses. Semantic Economy Valuation 001 sets out its own falsification conditions and dates the earliest deposit the capture registry holds.
